company_name: Shanghai Micro Electronics Equipment (Group) Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in optical lithography equipment, which is critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Shanghai Micro Electronics Equipment (SMEE) is a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector, focusing on the development and manufacturing of optical lithography systems. Their products are essential for both front-end and back-end semiconductor applications, including MEMS, flat panel displays, LEDs, and power devices.
